description: Find what the Greenlit books say about a question. Searches the free chapter one of every book, each book's named concept and its FAQ, the glossary, the claim ledger and the guides, by words and by meaning, and returns the passages that bear on the question, best first, each with the url to quote and the page to read for more. Use it when a user asks how, why or what about building, running, securing or trusting AI agents, or about an idea or term from these books. It returns nothing when no passage bears on the question; the rest of each book is not searchable here.

book.description: Restrict to one book, by slug.

question.description: The question in the user's words, e.g. why does my agent say it is done when the code is broken?

name: find_answer_in_books
title: Find the answer in the Greenlit books
